duration.text: The Management Science at Shanghai Maritime University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 6.Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be 18 or above 2.Be in good health condition 3.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate
